executive_summary.headline: Strait of Hormuz transits have collapsed 94% year-on-year while European waterway levels remain critically low, driving commodity price volatility across semiconductors and battery suppliers.
executive_summary.next_step: Within 24 hours, map exposure to energy-dependent production in EVE Energy, Infineon and Jabil supply chains; confirm whether recent price moves correlate with routing delays or feedstock cost shocks.
executive_summary.context: Hormuz transit collapse and Rhine low-water conditions—both logged this week—coincide with three unexplained double-digit percentage moves in high-exposure suppliers (EVE Energy down 4.2% and 5.3%, Infineon and Jabil each down 6%+ on 22 Oct). EU natural gas trading 131% above September baseline and Brent crude 30% above one-year median. Cause of individual stock moves remains unconfirmed, but the cluster timing and world-pillar severity warrant checking whether logistics cost or energy hedging…
